## Richness and decomposition

For the areas pair, long proofs were decomposed into determinant–height, separate parallelogram/triangle results, triangle degeneracy, interior diagonal, triangulation, face count, content additivity, and shoelace cancellation. The corollary pass added disc reconciliation, the collinearity criterion, and the triangulation face count.

For the improper-integral pair, exhaustion existence, nonnegative convergence, signed absolute convergence, uniform tails, continuity, differentiation, and the Gaussian computation are separate results. The Gaussian proof has dedicated finiteness, product, and polar lemmas. The corollary pass found no honest extra result beyond the retained comparison theorem.

Neither A page approaches the 60-item ceiling; no split is proposed.

## Findings for Alpha

1. Approve replacing a merely uniform derivative bound by an improper-integrable uniform dominator. The old RC-6 wording is false on infinite-volume domains.
2. Approve scoping “no conditional theory” to arbitrary compact exhaustions. Absolute convergence is forced by this convention in every dimension; one-variable conditional convergence uses ordered endpoint limits.
3. Approve using `thm-change-of-variables-for-compact-jordan-sets` directly in the Gaussian proof. The published annular-sector example does not state a general polar theorem.
4. Approve the filled-region polygon convention and its dictionary seam with the later boundary-curve convention.
5. Approve omitting a duplicate of `ex-triangle-has-jordan-content-one-half`; the general theorem computes the standard triangle locally.
6. Send the RC-4 determinant-prerequisite mismatch through the drift unit. The spec route closes transitively through `fubini-and-change-of-variables`.
7. Send the RC-6 uniform-convergence prerequisite mismatch through the drift unit. The retained proof derives uniform tails directly from domination.
8. Accept two orientation-only forward references to `def-polygonal-arc-and-polygon` and `thm-polygonal-jordan-curve` at order 357. Neither is load-bearing.

Exact applicable design edits and decline consequences are in [notes.md](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/frontier-16-batch-2.notes.md).

## Sources and dependency closure

The harvest used independent full-text treatments from [Trench](https://ramanujan.math.trinity.edu/wtrench/texts/TRENCH_REAL_ANALYSIS.PDF), [Taylor](https://mtaylor.web.unc.edu/wp-content/uploads/sites/16915/2018/04/analmv.pdf), [ETH geometry notes](https://ti.inf.ethz.ch/ew/courses/Geo20/lecture/gca20-4.pdf), [Erickson](https://jeffe.cs.illinois.edu/teaching/comptop/2017/chapters/01-simple-polygons.pdf), [MIT 18.101 notes](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/18-101-analysis-ii-fall-2005/babd982be745679b6d691f78b1c18f53_lectures.pdf), and [Trench’s improper-integral supplement](https://ramanujan.math.trinity.edu/wtrench/texts/TRENCH_IMPROPER_FUNCTIONS.PDF).

All 40 ids are new by fixed-string and semantic searches. All 63 external dependencies were opened from disk, are published, provenance-eligible, and earlier in reading order. There are no B-page dependency targets, generated dependency targets, external fallbacks, or current-run cross-batch dependencies.
